name: security-window-opener-authority-review
intent: Navigation authority through real window.opener and named-window relationships
artifacts: Link/window.open callsites, rel/target attributes, COOP headers, popup lifecycle and actual opener references.
trace: Establish how a lower-trust page retains an opener or reuses a named context, then which permitted cross-origin navigation operation reaches a trusted tab.
experiment: Use owned origins and visible benign navigation markers; compare the actual opener-linked path against an identical noopener or isolated-window control.
disproof: Modern implicit noopener, COOP separation or a null opener can invalidate a source-only concern; generic frameability is a different boundary.
repair: Remove unneeded opener authority and retest the actual popup flow, including required return messaging.
branch_decisions: Separate a newly opened blank target, an existing named window and a popup later navigating off origin. Confirm the opener survives the effective COOP group transition. Do not assume every target=_blank creates an opener, or that a popup blocker denial proves protection after an actual permitted popup opens.
